ADD.information: Add objects by drawing in the map. Start by choosing the type of object you want to draw below. Note that export to GPX only supports points and lines.

DELETE.information: Click the drawn object you want to delete, or click the button below to delete all drawn objects.

EDIT.information: Edit nodes (delete a node with alt-click), change the draw order, or change the color of drawn objects.

MOVE.information: Click the object in the map that you want to move to activate "move mode". Then drag the object to the right place.

OGC.information: Here you can choose an editable layer connected to a map server.
OGC.tooltip: Choose an editable layer to save to.

SAVE.information: Need a break? Save what you've drawn and continue later. Note that only the objects visible in the map are saved.

SETTINGS.information: Here you can change the tool's settings.
SETTINGS.tooltip: Change whether the objects' measurements are shown, etc.

UPLOAD.information: Import or export drawn objects in .kml/.gpx/.geojson format. Use the buttons below, or drag a file straight into the map.

buffer.selectAtLeastOne: You need to select at least one object in the map to buffer

sketch.drawingsRemovedServiceSelected: Drawn objects removed. Editable layer selected.

Arrow.label: Arrow
Arrow.tooltip: Draw an arrow in the map by clicking once per node, finish with a double click.

Circle.label: Circle
Circle.tooltip: Draw a circle in the map by clicking once where the circle should start, then drag to the size you want and release.

LineString.label: Line
LineString.tooltip: Draw a line in the map by clicking once per node, finish with a double click.

Point.label: Point
Point.tooltip: Add a point to the map by clicking where you want it.

Polygon.label: Polygon
Polygon.tooltip: Draw a polygon in the map by clicking once per node, finish with a double click.

Rectangle.label: Rectangle
Rectangle.tooltip: Draw a rectangle in the map by clicking once where the rectangle should start, then drag to the size you want and release.

Select.label: Select in the map
Select.tooltip: Click an existing object in the map to copy it into the drawing layer.

Text.label: Text
Text.tooltip: Add text to the map by clicking where you want it.
